# via gpio

Pin the variant and verify register side effects, DDRs and IRQ routing. Derive pin state from drivers and pull/hold policy. Test every port pin, timer edges, pin contention and register acknowledgement with bus and pin traces.

Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) for the workflow.
